# jochwacht-sbom 0.9.0 — the collector has a new name and a new license

- **jochwacht-sbom is now jochwacht-sbom.** Same tool, same code line, new
  name: it reads your build and writes your SBOM — the name says so.
  `pipx install jochwacht-sbom`; the `jochwacht-sbom` command keeps working
  (one line of notice), and the old PyPI package gets one last release as
  a forwarding shell that installs jochwacht-sbom.
- **License: GPL-3.0-or-later** from this release on. Releases up to
  jochwacht-sbom 0.8.6 stay MIT.
- Binary: `jochwacht-sbom-0.9.0-linux-x86_64` (+ .sha256).
